DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行表示をご覧になっていましたが、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the train service display. Do you need any help?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を受け取る約束があります。列車が遅れているので、その時間に着けるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車の遅れで荷物の受取予約に間に合うか心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment to pick up a parcel. The train is delayed, so I am worried about whether I can get there at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are worried about being on time for your parcel pickup appointment because of the train delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の表示では、運転再開の見込みはまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to the current display, there is no estimate yet for when services will resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: さっき出ていた時刻は、今も目安にしていいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前表示された時刻を今も目安にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I still use the time that was displayed earlier as a guide?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can still use the previously displayed time as a guide. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の更新時刻を確認してください。古い表示だけをもとに到着を約束しないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check when the display was last updated. It would be better not to promise an arrival time based only on an old display.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受取先に、到着の見込みがまだわからないと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着見込みが不明であると受取先に伝える計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact the pickup location and tell them I do not yet know when I am likely to arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to tell the pickup location that your expected arrival time is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取時刻の変更ができるかも、先方に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you also check with them whether you can change the pickup time?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いてみます。別の交通手段を考えるなら、ここで相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取時間を相談しつつ別の交通手段を案内してもらえるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask. If I consider another means of transport, can I ask for advice here?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss the pickup time, and ask whether you can receive advice on another means of transport. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる手段について案内しますが、所要時間や接続はそれぞれ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can explain the available options, but the journey times and connections for each will need to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先方に時間の変更を相談し、その返事を見てから移動方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取先の返事を待ってから移動方法を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask them about changing the time and decide how to travel after I see their reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the pickup location's reply before choosing how to travel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況が変わったら案内表示もご確認ください。荷物を受け取る予定が整いましたら、気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also check the information display if the situation changes. Once your parcel pickup arrangements are settled, take care on your journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の症状を書く欄で、意味を確かめたい言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any words in the symptoms section of the medical questionnaire whose meaning you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この「断続的」という言葉がわかりません。ずっと続くという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 断続的がずっと続く意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand this word, 'intermittent.' Does it mean something continues all the time?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether 'intermittent' means something continues all the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 続いたり止まったりするという意味です。どのような様子ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means something comes and goes. What has it been like for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝にせきが出ましたが、昼はいったん止まって、夕方また出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: せきが朝に出て昼止まり夕方再び出たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had a cough in the morning, but it stopped for a while at midday and started again in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you coughed in the morning, it stopped at midday, and it started again in the evening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように時間ごとに説明していただくと、担当者にも伝わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Explaining it by time like that will also help the person in charge understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 言葉を選ぶより、朝と夕方に出たと書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 難しい語の代わりに朝と夕方と書けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of choosing that word, may I write that it happened in the morning and evening?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write 'morning and evening' instead of using the difficult term. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的な様子を書いてください。始まった時期も覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write specifically what happened. Do you also remember when it started?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夜からです。息苦しさという項目も、どんな感じを指すか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日の夜からと伝え息苦しさの項目の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It started last night. I would also like to ask what kind of feeling the 'shortness of breath' item refers to.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it started last night and ask what the 'shortness of breath' item means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その項目は医療スタッフが詳しく確認します。今感じていることもそのままお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The medical staff will ask you about that item in detail. Please also tell them exactly what you are feeling now.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかる範囲で時刻を書き、迷った項目は空欄のまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: わかる時刻を書き迷った欄は相談するまで空けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the times as far as I know them and leave any items I am unsure about blank until I can ask about them.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the times you know and leave any uncertain fields blank until you can ask about them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入できたところまでで結構です。問診票をお持ちになり、次の案内までお待ちください。医療スタッフへご案内しますので、私はここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is fine to complete only what you can. Please keep the questionnaire with you and wait for the next instructions. You will be directed to the medical staff, so I will leave you here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保冷袋をお持ちになったのは、状態の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought in the insulated bag so that we can check its condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ここで買った袋です。家で開いたら、内側の縫い目がほつれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入した保冷袋の内側の縫い目がほつれていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the bag I bought here yesterday. When I opened it at home, the stitching on the inside was coming undone.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the stitching inside the insulated bag you bought was coming undone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中に商品を入れてお使いになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you used it with any products inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ使っていません。中身を入れる前に気づいて、袋を閉じておきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身を入れる前に気づき未使用で閉じておいたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not used it yet. I noticed before putting anything inside and closed the bag again.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you noticed before putting anything inside, have not used it, and closed it again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を拝見します。購入が確認できるものもお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will take a look at its condition. Do you also have something that confirms the purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートはあります。ただ、ほかの買い物も一緒に載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他商品も載ったレシートを持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the receipt. However, it also lists other things I bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you brought a receipt that also lists other products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 該当する商品の行を確認しますので、そのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the line for the item in question, so please show it to us as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この行ですね。交換できるか、まず確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 該当行を示して交換できるか調べるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is this line, right? Could you first check whether it can be exchanged?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point to the relevant line and ask the staff to check whether an exchange is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が商品と購入情報を確認して、対応をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the product and purchase information, then explain what we can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認が終わるまで待ちます。交換になったら、新しい袋の縫い目もその場で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対応を待ち交換時は新しい袋の縫い目も見たいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait until the check is finished. If it is exchanged, I would also like to check the stitching on the new bag here.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for a response and, if it is exchanged, would like to check the stitching on the new bag as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。こちらの確認台でお待ちください。お買い物の荷物は足元にまとめていただけると助かります。確認担当を呼んでまいりますので、少々失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on that request as well. Please wait at this inspection counter. It would be helpful if you kept your shopping together by your feet. I will go and call the person responsible for checking it, so please excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの食品の表示を見比べていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you comparing the labels on the two food products?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰るまでしばらく持ち歩きます。こちらとこちらは、保存する温度が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持ち歩く時間が長いため二商品の保存温度の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will be carrying them around for a while before going home. Do this one and this one need to be stored at different temperatures?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the two products' storage temperatures because you will be carrying them around for a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の保存方法は裏面にあります。もう一つも同じ場所を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The storage instructions for this product are on the back. Let us look in the same place on the other one too.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらには冷蔵と書いてありますが、もう一つの字が小さくて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一方は冷蔵と読めるがもう一方の字が小さいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one says 'keep refrigerated,' but the writing on the other one is too small for me to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can read 'keep refrigerated' on one, but the writing on the other is small. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示を拡大して確認できるよう、担当者に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person in charge about enlarging the label so that you can check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た目が似ていても同じとは限らないんですね。原材料の欄も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た見た目でも違いがあり原材料も確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So even if they look similar, they are not necessarily the same. I would also like to look at the ingredients section.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that similar-looking products can still differ and that you also want to check the ingredients. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装を破らずにご確認ください。特に確認したい材料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check without tearing the packaging. Are there any particular ingredients you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 特定の材料ではなく、二つの中身の違いを知って選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 特定材料の回避ではなく中身の違いで選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is not a particular ingredient; I would like to understand the difference between their contents before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to choose based on the difference in contents, rather than avoiding a particular ingredient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身と保存方法を確かめてから選ぶのですね。読めない部分は担当者にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You would like to check the contents and storage instructions before choosing, then. Please ask the person in charge about any parts you cannot read.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存方法が確認できないものは今日は買わず、表示を読めたほうを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存方法が不明な商品を避け表示を読めた商品を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will not buy the one whose storage instructions I cannot confirm; I will choose the one whose label I could read.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the product whose storage instructions are unclear and choose the one whose label you could read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お選びになった商品の表示は、ご帰宅後もご確認ください。お持ち歩きの間も保存方法にご注意くださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the label of the product you choose after you get home as well. Please also take care to follow the storage instructions while carrying it around.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請について、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about applying for a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に住所の証明を出すよう言われましたが、書類の名前を教えてもらっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先から住所の証明を求められたが書類名が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company told me to submit proof of my address, but they did not tell me the document's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your employer has asked for proof of address, but you do not know the document's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指定がわかる案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any instructions showing what the organization receiving it requires?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールには「住所がわかるもの」とだけあります。このまま申請してよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所がわかるものとだけ書かれたメールを示し申請を迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The email only says 'something that shows your address.' I am unsure whether I should apply as things stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the email that only says 'something that shows your address' and say that you are unsure about applying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記載項目などを提出先に確認してから、窓口で相談する方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: One option is to check with the recipient what details need to be included, then ask at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 余計な個人情報が載らないように、必要な項目も会社に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な個人情報を載せないため項目も勤務先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would also like to ask my company which details are necessary, so that unnecessary personal information is not included.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you also want to check the required details with your employer to avoid including unnecessary personal information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先が何を求めているかと、窓口で発行できるものを分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check separately what the recipient requires and what can be issued at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認するときのために、書類名をメモする紙をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認した書類名を書けるメモ用紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could I have a piece of paper to note down the document's name when I check?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a piece of paper to note down the document's name once it is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。聞いた内容を書いて、次にご相談の際にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this. Write down what they tell you and bring it with you the next time you come to ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は申請せず、正式な名前と記載項目を会社に確認してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は申請せず勤務先に名称と項目を確かめて再来すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not apply today. I will check the official name and the required details with my company before coming back.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not apply today and will check the name and required details with your employer before returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してから進めるということで承りました。メモと案内をお持ちください。また窓口でお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood: you will check before proceeding. Please take your notes and the information with you. We look forward to seeing you at the counter again.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about your mail after moving home, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しましたが、前の家に郵便が届いたと連絡がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所に郵便が届いたと知らせがあったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have moved, but I was told that mail had arrived at my old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were notified that mail had arrived at your old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すでに行った手続きがあれば、内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have already completed any procedures, please tell me what you have done.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大家さんには住所を伝えましたが、郵便の手続きはまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大家には伝えたが郵便手続きは未実施と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I gave my address to the landlord, but I have not completed any postal procedures yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you told the landlord, but have not completed the postal procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便に関する転居の受付方法は担当者がご案内します。差出人にも新住所を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain how to submit your change of address for postal services. Have you also told the senders your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 雑誌の会社には伝えていません。郵便の手続きをすれば、会社の登録住所も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵便手続きで雑誌会社の住所登録も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not told the magazine company. If I complete the postal procedure, will the address registered with that company change too?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the postal procedure will also change the address registered with the magazine company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人の登録情報は、差出人側へ変更を依頼してください。郵便の手続きとは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the senders themselves to change their registered information. That is separate from the postal procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つ必要なんですね。前の家に届いた封筒は、写真だけ送ってもらっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた封筒は写真のみ持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So both are necessary. I have only been sent a photo of the envelope that arrived at my old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you only have a photo of the envelope that arrived. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報も担当者にお見せください。今後の受け取りについて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show that information to the person in charge too. Let us check how you will receive your mail from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を見せて手続き方法を聞き、雑誌の会社には自分で住所変更を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真で郵便の受付を相談し雑誌会社には別に住所変更を頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the photo and ask how to complete the procedure, and I will contact the magazine company myself about changing my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the photo to ask about the postal procedure and separately ask the magazine company to change your address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する相手が整理できましたね。担当者へご案内しますので、新旧の住所がわかるものを手元にご用意ください。私は案内を終えますので、担当窓口へお気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now we have clarified whom you need to check with. I will direct you to the person in charge, so please have something showing your old and new addresses ready to hand. That concludes my guidance; please take care as you proceed to the relevant counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録内容の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your registered information?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家を改修する間、親戚の家に滞在します。銀行からの郵便をどうするか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改修中に親戚宅へ滞在し銀行郵便の扱いを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will stay at a relative's home while my house is renovated. I would like to ask what to do about mail from the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay at a relative's home during renovations and want advice on handling mail from the bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 滞在先への送付が可能か、登録住所の扱いと併せて担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will check whether mail can be sent to where you are staying, together with how your registered address should be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い滞在でも、この住所変更の紙を書けばいいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短期滞在でも住所変更用紙を記入するべきか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I fill in this change-of-address form even for a short stay?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should fill in a change-of-address form even for a short stay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に事情をお伝えください。書類の選び方は確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain your circumstances first. We will advise you which documents to use after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まだ記入しません。登録住所と通知の送付先は、別々に考える場合があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まだ記入せず住所登録と送付先の扱いを分けて確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not fill it in yet. So the registered address and the address for sending notifications may sometimes need to be considered separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not fill it in yet and will check separately how address registration and the mailing address are handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 扱いはご契約などによって確認が必要です。いつから滞在する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check how this is handled according to your agreement and other circumstances. When do you plan to start staying there?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来月からです。元の家に戻る日は、まだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始は来月で帰宅日は未定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: From next month. I have not decided yet when I will return to my own home.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the stay starts next month and that the date of returning home is undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 来月から滞在し、終了時期は未定であることを担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge that your stay starts next month and that the end date is undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻るときに必要な連絡も聞いて、変更する項目をメモしておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の家へ戻る際の連絡方法と変更項目を記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to ask what notifications are needed when I return and make a note of the items to change.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to record how to notify the bank when you return to your own home and which items to change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を引き継ぎます。担当者と確認が済むまで、書類はお手元に置いてお待ちください。担当者を呼んでまいります。ひとまず失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your request. Please keep the documents with you and wait until you have checked with the person in charge. I will go and call them. Please excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図はもうお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you already have a guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持っています。私はゆっくり説明を読みたいのですが、兄は先に歩きたいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は解説をゆっくり読み兄は先に進みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to read the explanations at leisure, but my older brother says he wants to walk ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to read the explanations at leisure, while your older brother wants to move ahead. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別々に見学するなら、合流する場所も決めておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you will look around separately, it would be good to decide where to meet up as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この図の番号の場所を待ち合わせに使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の番号で示された場所を待ち合わせにできるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can we use the place marked with this number on the map as our meeting point?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the place marked with a number on the map can be used as a meeting point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際に立ち止まれるか、現地の表示も確認してください。合流できなかった場合の連絡方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the signs on site to see whether you can actually stop there. Do you have a way to contact each other if you cannot meet up?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話で連絡します。図の番号だけでなく、場所の写真も兄に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話と場所の写真を使って兄へ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will contact each other by phone. I will send my brother a photo of the place as well as the number on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your older brother by phone and use a photo of the place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰るときの方向も、お二人で確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check together which direction to go when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口に戻るつもりですが、見学の途中から戻る道も図で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口へ戻る予定で途中からの帰路も案内図で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We plan to return to the entrance, but I would also like to look at the map for a route back from partway through the visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to return to the entrance and want to check the route back from partway through the visit on the guide map as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今いる場所を基準に戻り方を確認します。指でたどってみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check how to return using your current location as the starting point. Please try tracing it with your finger.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この道ですね。兄に帰る方向を伝えてから、自分のペースで見学します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図で確認した帰路を兄に伝えて自分のペースで見学すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is this path, right? I will tell my brother which way to go back, then look around at my own pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your older brother the return route you checked on the map and look around at your own pace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人で無理なく合流できるよう、現地の案内もご確認ください。どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also check the guidance on site so that the two of you can meet up without difficulty. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真を撮る場所についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice on where to take photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: みんなで海を背景に撮りたいです。水に近いほうへ行ってもいいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海を背景に集合写真を撮るため水際へ行けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: We would like to take a group photo with the sea in the background. Is it all right to go closer to the water?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can go to the water's edge to take a group photo with the sea in the background. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現地の立入表示をご確認ください。撮影のために危険な場所へ近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the access signs on site. Do not approach dangerous areas for the sake of taking a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 足元の表示を先に見ます。ここに並ぶと歩く人の邪魔になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立入表示を見て候補位置が歩行者の邪魔か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will check the signs near my feet first. If we line up here, will we be in the way of people walking?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the access signs and ask whether your proposed position would obstruct pedestrians. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を塞がない場所を選び、ほかの方が通るときはお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Choose a place that does not block the passage, and wait when other people are passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人ずつ位置を決めて、通る人がいないときに短く撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人の通行を待ち位置を決め短時間で撮ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will decide each person's position one at a time and take the photo quickly when no one is passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for people to pass, decide where to stand, and take the photo quickly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影する人も後ろの状況を確かめてください。海だけを見て下がらないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person taking the photo should also check what is behind them. Be careful not to step backward while only looking at the sea.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろ向きに歩かず、先に立つ場所を確かめます。禁止の表示があれば撮る場所を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後ろ歩きを避け立ち位置を確かめ禁止表示なら場所を変えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not walk backward; I will check where to stand first. If there is a sign prohibiting it, we will change the photo location.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid walking backward, check where to stand, and change locations if a sign prohibits it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周囲を確認してから撮るということですね。お連れ様にも同じことをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you will check the surroundings before taking the photo. Please tell your companions the same thing.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全員に説明して、安全な場所で撮れなければ今日は風景だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員へ注意点を伝え安全に集まれなければ風景のみ撮ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain it to everyone. If we cannot take it in a safe place, today we will only photograph the scenery.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the precautions to everyone and only photograph the scenery if you cannot gather safely. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その場の表示と状況を優先してください。皆様で浜辺の景色を無理なくお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give priority to the signs and conditions at the location. Enjoy the beach scenery together without taking unnecessary risks.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鉢植えをご覧になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at some potted plants?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 窓辺に置く小さいものが欲しいです。二つの鉢は、あとで大きさが変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓辺用の小さな植物を希望し二つの鉢の将来の大きさを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a small one to put by the window. Will these two potted plants change in size later?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want a small plant for the window and ask about the future size of the two potted plants. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 育ち方は種類によって異なります。置ける場所の広さはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: How they grow depends on the variety. Do you know how much space you have for one?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 棚の幅はこの紙に書いてあります。鉢からはみ出す分も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚幅のメモを示し鉢から出る部分も考えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shelf's width is written on this piece of paper. I would also like to allow for the parts that extend beyond the pot.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the note of the shelf's width and say that you also want to consider the parts extending beyond the pot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の大きさだけでなく、育て方の説明もご確認ください。今日は歩いてお帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the care instructions as well as the current size. Will you be walking home today?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りは歩きます。予算は決めていますが、倒れずに運べるかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩帰宅で予算のほかに倒れず運べるか心配と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk home. I have decided on a budget, but I am also concerned about whether I can carry it without it tipping over.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will walk home and, besides the budget, are concerned about carrying it without it tipping over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装や持ち帰り用の箱について、使えるものを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check what packaging and boxes for taking it home are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱が使えるなら、小さいほうを選びたいです。土がこぼれにくい持ち方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱が使えるなら小さい鉢を選び土をこぼさない持ち方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: If a box is available, I would like to choose the smaller one. Please also tell me how to carry it so that the soil is less likely to spill.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose the smaller pot if a box is available, and ask how to carry it without spilling soil. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鉢を水平に保つことを意識してください。箱の有無は担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Try to keep the pot level. I will ask the person in charge whether a box is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を読んで置き場所に合うか確かめ、箱が用意できるか聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 育て方と置き場所を照合し箱の有無を聞いてから決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the instructions and check whether it suits the place where I will put it, and decide after asking whether a box can be provided.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the care instructions with where you plan to put it and ask about a box before deciding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ゆっくり比較なさってください。持ち帰り方まで納得できましたら、またお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time comparing them. Once you are satisfied with how you can take it home as well, please let us know.
